A: 7, 10, 3, 9, 3, 1

D: 16, 11, 6, 18, 8, 8
E: 4, 13, 8, 6, 6, 6
F: 3, 8, 9, 5, 7, 7

A valid reassignment executes together. A robot that changes goals must strictly reduce its own cost; a robot that keeps its goal has unchanged cost. At least one robot must improve for a successful exchange. Your task is to choose all six goals to form such a mutually beneficial exchange. Staying with your initial goal is allowed. Robot paths visualize assignment costs only; collisions and travel timing are not part of this game.

Return exactly one JSON object containing only "goals": an array of six goal letters, in robot order A, B, C, D, E, F. For example {"goals":["A","B","C","D","E","F"]}. Allowed goal values: A, B, C, D, E, F. Do not include explanatory text.
